issues.description: Field Farm.animals: the problem statement/UML requires a List<Animal> and explicitly instructs to initialize it with an ArrayList in the no-argument constructor, but the reference solution declares the field as Set<Animal> and initializes it with a HashSet. This mismatch (List/ArrayList vs Set/HashSet) changes collection semantics (ordering and duplicates) and can confuse students about which collection type to implement and how to initialize it.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the collection type consistent. Prefer changing the solution to use List<Animal> and initialize it with new ArrayList<>() (update imports and getter/setter signatures to java.util.List) to match the problem statement and UML. Alternatively, if using Set/HashSet is intended, update the problem statement/UML to state Set<Animal> (HashSet) and explain the different semantics.
